# ClearGlass Inc

> Enterprise cybersecurity, AI automation, autonomous agents, OSINT, digital
> investigations, and software architecture. Based in Burlington, Ontario,
> Canada and serving clients worldwide.

ClearGlass Inc builds governed security platforms, autonomous AI systems,
investigative/OSINT tooling, and enterprise workflow systems. The site is the
official home of the Artemis, Guardian, Sentinel, Conduit, and Percival systems.

## Platform and products
- [Artemis IV Core](https://www.clearglassinc.com/artemis-iv.html) — governed autonomous AI security platform
- [Guardian](https://www.clearglassinc.com/guardian.html) — zero-trust security command center
- [Sentinel](https://www.clearglassinc.com/sentinel.html) — live geospatial intelligence command center
- [Conduit](https://www.clearglassinc.com/conduit.html) — enterprise workflow automation
- [ClearGlass NEXUS](https://www.clearglassinc.com/clearglass-nexus.html) — intelligence platform
- [Percival OS](https://www.clearglassinc.com/percival-os.html) — governed command center

- AI engineering, LLM orchestration, and governed multi-agent systems
